author: Dr15Jones
body:
#### PR description:

When using `wantSummary` from the `process.options` configuration, the trigger report is now handled by a Service rather than by code embedded into the various framework components. This required extending the ModuleCallingContext to have the state of the module after the module ran (i.e. `passed`, `failed` or `exception`).

Minor changes were done to the summary
- the labels for modules in the path reports now include any modifiers applied to the modules (e.g. a `not` appears as a `!` at the beginning of the label)
- OutputModule `executed` count is now the time the `write` was called (i.e. takes into account any path filtering) while in the passed `executed` was just the same as `visited`.

#### PR validation:

Code compiles. Framework unit tests pass.

resolves https://github.com/cms-sw/framework-team/issues/2389
resolves https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/issues/51655
title: TriggerReport summary now handled by a service
